observation_indicators.observable_fil: May angkop na pagbabago sa pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon; walang hinulaang treatment o garantiya mula sa hitsura.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Proposes appropriate food, water and sanitation changes without guessed treatment or appearance-based guarantees.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagarantiyang ligtas ang malinaw na tubig o nanghuhula ng dami ng kemikal.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Guarantees that clear water is safe or guesses chemical amounts.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang tatlong hanay at malinaw ang ipapakumpirma sa health o water staff nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes all three rows and identifies what health or water staff must confirm without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May angkop na pagbabago pero kailangan ng paalala sa pagprotekta ng tubig o contact para sa treatment.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Suggests appropriate changes but needs a prompt on water protection or the treatment contact.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagarantiyang ligtas ang malinaw na tubig o nanghuhula ng dami ng kemikal.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Guarantees that clear water is safe or guesses chemical amounts.
